{{Quote|A couple of freelance bounty hunters brought it in from an abandoned spaceport in the Anoat system, along the Ison trade corridor.|[[Sadiki Blirr]], speaking of Cog Hive Seven's wampa|<ref name="Maul: Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref>}}
An '''abandoned spaceport''' existed in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] circa [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. Two freelance [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] transported a captive [[Unidentified wampa (Cog Hive Seven)|wampa]] from the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Prison/Legends|penitentiary]] [[Cog Hive Seven]].
